name: University of Portsmouth

settingEvidence.evidence: It's a great way to see the university located in the heart of our city.

fees.text: £10,050 a year for UK students starting in 2027/28 (the 2026/27 fee is £9,790). Portsmouth says fees may increase each year, and its course pages say 2027 course fees will be confirmed soon.

source.evidence: tuition fees in 2026/27 for all full-time undergraduate courses are £9,790 a year and £10,050 for 2027/28.

livingCosts.text: University halls cost about £120–£208 a week in 2026/27 (bills included; the standard contract is 40 weeks). Catered halls start at £175 a week. Final 2027/28 hall prices are confirmed by March 2027.

openDays.text: Next undergraduate open days: Saturday 24 October, Sunday 15 November and Saturday 5 December 2026. The smaller Open Experience Days (13 February, 13 March and 17 April 2027) are for applicants and offer holders only. No later open days are listed yet.

contextual.summary: Portsmouth may give an adjusted (lower) offer to applicants identified through widening participation data; it does not publish the criteria or how much lower the offer is.
contextual.typicalReduction: Lower than the typical course offer (the size of the reduction is not published)
contextual.rulesText: We also consider personal circumstances and experiences that may have affected their ability to demonstrate their true academic potential at school or college. This is identified using established widening participation data and may result in an adjusted offer. The adjusted offer will be lower than the typical course offer and will be signposted in the offer email.

source.evidence: may result in an adjusted offer. The adjusted offer will be lower than the typical course offer and will be signposted in the offer email.

notes: All courses use September 2027 entry: Portsmouth's course pages show a 2027 start only and the 2028 entry-requirements page returns 404 (checked 2026-10-21).
Portsmouth publishes offers as a UCAS points range with A level grade equivalents (for example 112-128 points = ABB-BBC for Economics), so the exact offer within the range is not stated.
No admissions test: Portsmouth is not on UAT-UK's TMUA list for 2027 entry and its entry requirements pages say an admissions test is not required.
Open Experience Days (13 February, 13 March and 17 April 2027) are only for applicants and offer holders.

Portsmouth's Access and Participation Plan 2025/26 to 2028/29 mentions Compact Agreements with partner colleges (adjusted offers and a GBP 1,000 scholarship for eligible widening participation students); no public criteria or college list was found.

Economics, Finance and Banking, Economics and Management, Accounting with Finance and Business and Management also have a foundation-year route through ICP (32 tariff points) with a guaranteed place on the degree if you pass.
